[[File:FirefighterBattleDroid-TCWCEJtB.png|thumb|right|220px|A Firefighter droid]]
'''Firefighter droids''', '''fire-control droids''', or '''firefighting robos'''<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> were specialized firefighting droids. They were mainly used on bases or ships.

==Description==
Firefighter droids were designed to operate in environments that were inhospitable to organic beings. They were capable of withstanding extreme heat to perform their duties.<ref name="EGTD" />

==History==
[[File:Firefighting_Droids.png|thumb|left|280px|Firefighting droids in action]]
Firefighter droids serving the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] were similar to their [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] counterparts by having darker coloration, with several yellow stripes marking their appearance. A group of firefighting battle droids used [[firehose]]s that were attached to the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] in order to blast heavy streams of foam on fires that had broken out in the ship's hangar bay.<ref name="DM">{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref> The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] left some of them on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. [[Jaybo Hood/Legends|Jaybo Hood]] later mixed these units with parts from other leftover [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="M">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref> 

The [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] developed the modular [[Inferno firefighting robo]] for use throughout the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] in both governmental and private-funded fire stations. The versatile droids could be deployed individually or in teams to combat fires.<ref name="EGTD" /> Firefighter droids employed by [[Nebula Consumables]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tyed Kant]] were colored in white and crimson.<ref name="MC">{{WEGCite|story=The Mynock Conspiracy|book=Supernova (sourcebook)}}</ref>
